game.title: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
game.blurb: Action-platformer from Insomniac Games (PC port by Nixxes Software), released 2021-06-11. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1895880)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (ratchetandclank.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://ratchetandclank.fandom.com/wiki/Ratchet_&_Clank:_Rift_Apart
notes: No StrategyWiki page (also tried "Ratchet and Clank: Rift Apart"). ratchetandclank.fandom.com answers the API, with about 141 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Quartz" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1895880. 15 of 47 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter, though a few (such as "Hey Lombax DJ" and "Lombax and Chill") may be optional side moments and need checking.
